title: ProxyGuard: Direct Reliability Inference for Randomized Data Release Mechanisms with Shared Targets
abstract: arXiv:2608.18643v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Researchers often choose a proxy dataset from many releases, transformations, or seeds. Search can make an invalid release appear adequate, while one adequate release does not establish that its generator is reliable. ProxyGuard controls both errors using prespecified bounded risks and a sealed target set. Named-release mode corrects for multiplicity and certifies specific releases. Direct shared-target mode evaluates independent mechanism draws on a common target, lower-bounds their favorable-score rate, and subtracts a bound on favorable scores contributed by invalid releases. Conditional on the target, release scores are independent, yielding a finite-sample mechanism-reliability guarantee without independent target batches or assumptions on release-level $p$-value dependence. translated_title: ProxyGuard：针对共享目标的随机数据发布机制的直接可靠性推断
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.18643v1 公告类型：新 摘要：研究人员通常从多个发布、变换或种子中选择一个代理数据集。搜索可能使无效发布看起来足够好，而一个足够的发布并不能证明其生成器是可靠的。ProxyGuard通过预设的有界风险和密封目标集来控制这两种错误。命名发布模式校正多重性并认证特定发布。直接共享目标模式在共同目标上评估独立机制抽取，下界其有利评分率，并减去无效发布贡献的有利评分界限。以目标为条件，发布评分是独立的，从而在没有独立目标批次或发布级$p$值依赖性假设的情况下，提供有限样本机制可靠性保证。我们证明均值惩罚是尖锐的，并推导出具有加性目标浓度的平滑评分证书。在一项注册的三要求研究中，d
tldr: ProxyGuard提出了一种基于密封目标集和预设风险的新方法，能够在随机数据发布机制中同时控制无效发布被误认为有效和有效发布未被认证的错误，无需独立目标批次或发布级依赖假设。
en_tdlr: ProxyGuard introduces a sealed target set and prespecified bounded risks to simultaneously control false validity and missed certification in randomized data release mechanisms, requiring no independent target batches or release-level dependence assumptions.
